def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); out=[r[:] for r in I]
    # find pattern: non-zero cells; pattern cells exclude stray single 5s
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pat={(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in cells}
    # anchor: cell whose color count in pattern is 1 (demo case: 5)
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in cells: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    anchor=next(v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1)
    acolor=[v for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]
    acr,crc=[r for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]-r0, [c for r,c,v in cells if v==anchor][0]-c0
    strays=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5]
    for mr,mc in strays:
        tl=(mr-acr, mc-crc)
        for (rr,cc,v) in pat:
            r,cc2=tl[0]+rr,tl[1]+cc
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=cc2<W: out[r][cc2]=v
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

import json
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in I]
    cells=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in cells: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    # anchor: unique color
    unic=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
    anchor=unic[0]
    acr,crc=None,None
    for r,c,v in cells:
        if v==anchor:
            acr,crc=r-min(r for rr,cc,_ in cells),c-min(cc for rr,cc,_ in cells)
    r0=min(rr for rr,cc,_ in cells); c0=min(cc for rr,cc,_ in cells)
    pat=[(r-r0,c-c0,v) for r,c,v in cells if v!=anchor]
    for mr,mc in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5]:
        tl=(mr-acr,mc-crc)
        for rr,cc,v in pat:
            r,cc2=tl[0]+rr,tl[1]+cc
            if 0<=r<H and 0<=cc2<W: out[r][cc2]=v
    return out
print(all(f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']))
res=f(G['Test input'])
for r in res: print(r)

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]

    mks=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r][c]==5]

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    pat=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pat]; cs=[p[1] for p in pat]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # anchor: 5 inside pattern bbox; otherwise the unique-colored pattern cell
    inb=[p for p in pat if r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1 and p[2]==5]
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in pat: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    uniq=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if n==1]
    anchor=inb[0] if inb else next(p for p in pat if p[2] in uniq)
    strays=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5 and (r,c)!=anchor and (r<c0 or r>r1 or c<c0 or c>c1)]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for sr,sc in strays:
        dr,dc=sr-anchor[0],sc-anchor[1]
        for pr,pc,v in pat:
            rr,cc=pr+dr,pc+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: O[rr][cc]=v
    return O

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
res=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    pat=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pat]; cs=[p[1] for p in pat]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    cnt={}
    for _,_,v in pat: cnt[v]=cnt.get(v,0)+1
    mk=[p for p in pat if p[2]==5 and r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1]
    # anchor selection: inside 5 > singleton color > else TL
    if mk: anchor=mk[0]
    elif any(n==1 for n in cnt.values()):
        for p in sorted(pat):
            if cnt[p[2]]==1: anchor=p; break
    else: anchor=pat[0]
    strays=[p for p in pat if p[2]==5 and (p[0]<r0 or p[0]>r1 or p[1]<c0 or p[1]>c1)]

        dr,dc=s[0]-anchor[0],s[1]-anchor[1]
        for pr,pc,v in pat:
            if (pr,pc)==anchor: continue
            rr,cc=pr+dr,pc+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: O[rr][cc]=v
        O[s[0]][s[1]]=0
    return O

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    P=solve(G[k+' input']); O=G[k+' output']

        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    pat=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0 and I[r][c]!=5]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pat]; cs=[p[1] for p in pat]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    fives=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==5]
    # anchor: 5 inside pattern bbox if any; else 5 closest to the pattern bbox
    def dist(p,box): return min(abs(p[0]-r) for r in range(r0,r1+1))+min(abs(p[1]-c) for c in range(c0,c1+1))
    mk=[p for p in fives if r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1]
    anchor=mk[0] if mk else min(fives,key=lambda p:(dist(p,(r0,c0,r1,c1)),p[0],p[1]))
    fives=[p for p in fives if p!=anchor]
    O=[r[:] for r in I]

    targets=fives+[mk[0]] if mk else fives+[anchor] if len(fives)>1 else []
    targets=set(targets)
    for (sr,sc) in targets:

        for pr,pc,v in pat:

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    a,b=GG[f'Demo pair {i} input'],GG[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    h,w=len(a),len(a[0])
    best=None
    for dr in range(-h,h):
        for dc in range(-w,w):
            bad=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if b[r][c]!=a[r-dr and 0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w or True] if not(0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w))
            sc=sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if 0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w and b[r][c]==a[r-dr][c-dc])
            total=h*w
            # count mismatches over full output: output cells not covered by shifted input
            ncover=sc; covers=(total-sc); extra=0
            bad_covers = sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if 0<=r-dr<h and 0<=c-dc<w and b[r][c]!=a[r-dr][c-dc])
            unmapped=total-ncover-bad_covers
            s=unmapped+bad_covers
            if best is None or s<best[0]: best=(s,dr,dc)
    print(i,'best',best[0],'shift',best[1],best[2])
